es: Comparar una conversación con su versión reportada y detectar distorsiones de tiempo, persona o sentido.

vocabulary.es: el original, lo que se dijo de verdad

teaching.en: Tom said he was tired then.
teaching.es: Tom dijo que estaba cansado en ese momento.
teaching.explanationEs: Now → then: el «ahora» de la cita original pasa a «entonces»; am → was.
teaching.audioText: Tom said he was tired then.

teaching.en: Ana said she had been there the day before.
teaching.es: Ana dijo que había estado allí el día anterior.
teaching.explanationEs: Here → there y yesterday → the day before; el tiempo retrocede un paso (was → had been).
teaching.audioText: Ana said she had been there the day before.

teaching.en: The original was «I might come», but the report says she promised to come, so that version is distorted.
teaching.es: El original era «quizá venga», pero el reporte dice que prometió venir, así que esa versión está distorsionada.
teaching.explanationEs: Una versión distorsionada cambia la fuerza de lo dicho: might no es promised.
segments: The original was «I might come», but the report says
she promised to come, so that version is distorted.
teaching.audioText: The original was «I might come», but the report says she promised to come, so that version is distorted.

teaching.en: She said «a few people», but the report says «hundreds», so it is exaggerated.
teaching.es: Ella dijo «unas pocas personas», pero el reporte dice «cientos», así que está exagerado.
teaching.explanationEs: Exaggerated: hace algo más grande de lo que fue.
segments: She said «a few people», but the
report says «hundreds», so it is exaggerated.
teaching.audioText: She said «a few people», but the report says «hundreds», so it is exaggerated.

teaching.en: An accurate report keeps every detail: who said it, what they said and when.
teaching.es: Un reporte exacto conserva cada detalle: quién lo dijo, qué dijo y cuándo.
teaching.explanationEs: Accurate + detail: no se omite ni se añade información.
segments: An accurate report keeps every detail: who
said it, what they said and when.
teaching.audioText: An accurate report keeps every detail: who said it, what they said and when.

teaching.en: In a faithful version, «I may be late» becomes He said he might be late.
teaching.es: En una versión fiel, «puede que llegue tarde» se convierte en Dijo que quizá llegaría tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: May → might: el grado de posibilidad se mantiene al retroceder.
segments: In a faithful version, «I may be late»
becomes He said he might be late.
teaching.audioText: In a faithful version, «I may be late» becomes He said he might be late.

prompt.es: Elige el reporte fiel de lo que dijo Tom.

choices.text: Tom said I was very tired then.
Tom said he was very tired then.
Tom said he was very tired and wanted to go home.

feedback.es: Fiel: I → he, am → was y now → then. Una versión cambia mal la persona (I) y otra añade información que Tom no dijo.

hint.es: Compara la persona, el tiempo del verbo y la palabra now, y mira si se añade algo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reporte respeta lo que dijo Ana?

choices.text: Ana promised to come to the party.
Ana said she would come to the party.
Ana said she might come to the party.

feedback.es: May pasa a might y conserva la posibilidad. Promised la convierte en compromiso y would la presenta como segura.

hint.es: Might mantiene la posibilidad de may; promised y would la cambian.

origin.text: Original: «I may come to the party.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Leo dijo que vendrían al día siguiente.»

feedback.es: Tomorrow se convierte en the next day cuando reportas en otro momento.

hint.es: Tomorrow se convierte en the … day.

origin.text: Leo said they would come the ___ day.

prompt.es: Escucha a Mia y elige el reporte fiel.

choices.text: Mia said she couldn't come that night because she was busy.
Mia said she didn't want to come that night.
Mia said she couldn't come the next night because she was busy.

feedback.es: Fiel: can't → couldn't, tonight → that night y I'm busy → she was busy. Una versión cambia «no puedo» por «no quiero» y otra cambia la noche.

origin.audio: I can't come tonight. I'm busy.

prompt.es: Elige el reporte fiel de la cita original.

choices.text: She said they would see the match the day before.
She said they had seen the match the day before.
She said they had seen the match the next day.

feedback.es: Fiel: we → they, saw → had seen y yesterday → the day before. Una versión cambia el tiempo (would see mira al futuro) y otra cambia el día (the next day).

prompt.es: Empareja cada frase original (izquierda) con su reporte fiel (derecha).

pairs.es: She said she had lost her keys.
He said he could swim there.
They said they would help me the next day.
She said she had seen him the day before.

feedback.es: En cada reporte cambian persona, tiempo y referencias: have lost → had lost, can → could, here → there, yesterday → the day before.

pairs.es: She said she had lost her keys.
He said he could swim there.
They said they would help me the next day.
She said she had seen him the day before.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reporte conserva la condición que puso Mia?

choices.text: Mia said she would call me.
Mia said I would call her if I finished early.
Mia said she would call me if she finished early.

feedback.es: Fiel: will → would, I → she y se conserva la condición (if she finished early). Una versión omite la condición y otra cambia quién llama.

origin.text: Original: «I'll call you if I finish early.»

prompt.es: Escucha a Carlos y elige el reporte fiel.

choices.text: Carlos said he had bought the tickets the day before.
Carlos said he would buy the tickets the next day.
Carlos said I had bought the tickets the day before.

feedback.es: Fiel: I → he, bought → had bought y yesterday → the day before. Una versión cambia el pasado por futuro y otra cambia la persona.

prompt.es: Completa: «Dijo que estaba contenta en ese momento.»

feedback.es: Now se convierte en then al reportar en pasado.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Mia dijo que llamaría al día siguiente.»

answer.text: Mia said she would call the next day

feedback.es: Will → would y tomorrow → the next day: el reporte fiel cambia las dos cosas.

prompt.es: Elige el reporte que no exagera lo que dijo Leo.

choices.text: Leo said hundreds of people had come to the meeting.
Leo said a few people had come to the meeting.
Leo said a few people would come to the meeting.

feedback.es: Fiel: a few people se mantiene y came pasa a had come. Una versión exagera la cifra (hundreds) y otra cambia el pasado por futuro.

origin.text: Original: «A few people came to the meeting.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace el reporte de Tom.

choices.text: It keeps Ana's words exactly.
It makes Ana's promise stronger.
It makes Ana's promise weaker.

feedback.es: Definitely pasa a might: la seguridad de Ana se debilita. Es una distorsión, no un reporte fiel.

origin.audio: Ana said she would definitely come. Tom told us that Ana said she might come.

feedback.es: May → might: la posibilidad se mantiene al retroceder el tiempo.
